messages:
maya_devex: Heads-up — hitting a weird ordering/regression when the batching-helper (v0.3) retries after an auth refresh. vectrix-sampleapp uses the helper to batch embed calls, but when a token refresh triggers a retry one item ends up returned first and our rerank mapping (which currently assumes response order == request order) gets scrambled. :facepalm:

maya_devex: Minimal repro outline attached below. Not a big thread but this is blocking a couple of onboarding users.

maya_devex: Request (logical order):
```json
[
  {"id":"q1","text":"How does X work?"},
  {"id":"q2","text":"Where to find Y?"},
  {"id":"q3","text":"Compare A vs B"}
]
```

maya_devex: Observed response when retry reordered: (SDK maps by array index)
```json
[
  {"embedding": [...], "meta": {...}},  // corresponds to q2 but SDK puts at index 0
  {"embedding": [...], "meta": {...}},  // q1 ends up at index 1
  {"embedding": [...], "meta": {...}}   // q3 stays last
]
```

maya_devex: Result: reranker ties vector->document using array position, so q2 gets q1's doc and ranking is garbage. Repro steps: run vectrix-sampleapp with NODE_ENV=staging, force an auth refresh (short token), and spike one request to trigger retry path.

sam_sdk: Ugh. I think this is a parity/assumption problem across SDKs. Python helper attaches an explicit "client_index" in the single-item envelope; Node helper relies on positional mapping.

sam_sdk: Quick log snippet from node: 
```
batching-helper: sending batch of 3
auth: token expired, refreshing
retry: re-sending item 2 separately
response: [vec_for_q2, vec_for_q1, vec_for_q3]
map_by_index -> mismatch
```

linus_infra: We should be defensive and include an opaque ID on each item in the request body and require the server to mirror it in responses, or the client should map by an "id" field in the response. If server can't guarantee ordering on retries, positional mapping is dangerous.

linus_infra: Short proposal: add "client_item_id" to the helper payload and pass it through unchanged in the embeddings response envelope. That lets SDKs map deterministically. Backwards compat: if absent, fall back to current behavior but log a warning.

ben_product: How invasive is that change? Would it break existing customers? Is backward compatibility easy?

sam_sdk: Non-breaking if we make it optional. Node + Python SDKs can be updated to prefer the id mapping when present. Then we can update sampleapp templates and add a tiny migration note.

maya_devex: I opened a tiny PR on the helper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/vectrix-sample/pull/42 — it adds client_item_id and a small unit test that simulates the retry reorder. Please review.

maya_devex: Also noticed response format differences: python SDK returns an array of objects with "id" and "vector", node returns bare vectors for perf. We should converge on returning a response envelope when any item in the batch has metadata/ids.

sam_sdk: Agree. Parity checklist item: embeddings response should be an array of objects {"id"?: string, "vector": [floats], "meta"?: {...}}. SDKs can accept either but prefer objects. I'll add to the SDK parity issue tracker.

linus_infra: Operational note: this was partly exposed by auth/retry because our retry path currently does a split-send for failed items instead of keeping original ordering. We can fix server-side to preserve original index when reassembling a batched reply, but client-side ids are still safer.

ben_product: For onboarding docs: update 'vectrix-sampleapp' quickstart to show safe mapping pattern (attach id) and callout about older SDK versions. I'll draft a blurb.

maya_devex: Action items: 1) sam -> add id-envelopes parity change to SDK tracker; 2) linus -> consider server-side preserve-index fix; 3) maya -> update sampleapp PR and test cases; 4) docs -> ben will add quickstart note.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: batching-helper/0.3.1 -> canary in staging (job #4023).

sam_sdk: Thanks — I'll prioritize a node SDK patch to map by id when present and add tests that simulate auth-refresh reorder.

maya_devex: Thanks all. If anyone oncall sees weird rerank reports from new signups, ping me and I'll revert the helper to v0.3 until we get the parity patch out. :pray:
